subject: lavaan ERROR: missing="ml" is not allowed for estimator “mlm”

messages.author: 23027041e22bd9f8
messages.subject: lavaan ERROR: missing="ml" is not allowed for estimator “mlm”
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to run an SEM with ANES data that includes missing data and I'm getting an error that I don't understand but that seems to be connected to using MLR with fiml

When I run the model without sample weights, there are no problems.

***
model1<-'

cand20=~V201151+V201152
cand16=~V161086+ V161087

cand20~cand16
'
modelfit1<- sem(model1, data = anes1620nomiss, estimator = "MLR", missing="fiml")

summary(modelfit1, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

***

This runs with no problems. 

However, when I try to use lavaan.survey on this model:

***

modelfit1.survey <- lavaan.survey(modelfit1, survey.design = anes1620survey)

***

I run into this error:

lavaan ERROR: missing="ml" is not allowed for estimator “mlm”

Is it not possible to use fiml with MLR?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: missing="ml" is not allowed for estimator “mlm”
parts:
I think lavaan.survey relies on estimator = "MLM", which in turn does
not allow for missing = "ml".

If you just need to correct for a single cluster variable, then you can try

sem(model1, data = anes1620nomiss, estimator = "MLR", missing="fiml",
cluster = "myClusterVariable")

where you fill in the right name for the cluster variable, and you get a
so called cluster-robust fit (similar to type = complex in Mplus). This
also works with sampling.weights.

Yves.
